Phoenix, Arizona · coffee

Coffee in Phoenix for cyclists

Where riders in Phoenix start the day and finish the ride.

Coffee in Phoenix for cyclists, listed

  1. Regroup Coffee + Bicycles

    • A group ride starts here
    • 1205 N Scottsdale Rd, Tempe, AZ 85288
    • 6:30 a.m. to noon Tuesday to Thursday, 6:30 a.m. to 2 p.m. Friday to Sunday; closed Monday

    The ride from here: Regroup Saturday Coffee Ride (Saturdays, 6:30 am) →

    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Regroup Coffee + Bicycles

    Tempe, on Scottsdale Rd about 8 miles east of downtown Phoenix: a café and bike shop in one room, and the start and finish of Regroup’s coffee ride (Saturdays, 6:30 am), which comes back here for coffee and pastries (Chacónne Patisserie, per the home page). The café door opens at 6:30, so the coffee is after the ride, not before; closed Monday. The café’s page says nothing about bike parking or a pump. The bike shop side is under Bike shops.

  2. Village Coffee Roastery

    • 8120 N Hayden Rd, Scottsdale, AZ 85258
    • 6 a.m. daily; closes at 2 or 4 p.m. (the listings disagree)
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Village Coffee Roastery

    Scottsdale, in McCormick Ranch, about a mile and a half east of the Gainey Village corner where Scottsdale Cycling’s rides: Gainey Tuesday (Flat Route) (Tuesdays, 5:30 am); Gainey Thursday (Thursdays, 5:30 am); The Saturday Ride (Fuss Buss) (Saturdays, 6:00 am) leave. It opens at 6 every day, after the dawn rides have rolled, so this is the coffee after. Breakfast and a sidewalk patio, per two listings. Call (480) 905-0881 before you count on it.

  3. Fountain View Coffee

    Fountain Hills, about 23 miles from downtown Phoenix, on Saguaro Blvd, the road the Rio Verde – Fountain Hills loop follows to Shea.

    • 12645 N Saguaro Blvd Ste 17, Fountain Hills, AZ 85268
    • 6 a.m. to 3 p.m. daily
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Fountain View Coffee

    It is about half a mile north of McDowell Mountain Cycles, where the shop’s road ride (Some Saturdays, 6:30 am) and Sunday Funday gravel (Some Sundays, 6:30 am) leave. Open 6 to 3 every day, with a back patio facing the fountain, per two listings; call (805) 310-1544 first.

  4. Lux Central

    Central Phoenix, on Central Avenue about 3.5 miles north of downtown, open 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. every day, per its site.

    • 4402 N Central Ave, Phoenix, AZ 85012
    • 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Lux Central

    The early café in central Phoenix; it is not at a ride start, and it is still open after an evening ride. TripAdvisor lists outdoor seating; nothing says bikes.

Checked October 3, 2026. No paid placements. Businesses open and close; call before you count on anyone.
